text:
sqlpipe v2.0 introduces key improvements for faster, more flexible data pipelines.

Breaking change: `/v2/users` now returns `first_name` and `last_name` instead of the single `name` field. Update downstream consumers, mappings, and schemas before upgrading.

New: use the `--incremental` flag to process only new or changed data, reducing unnecessary work in recurring jobs.

Performance: Parquet writes are now up to 40% faster, improving throughput for large exports and warehouse-bound workflows.

Review your API integrations and migration scripts before deploying v2.0.
